snippet.title: Game Dev Journey of a Lifetime | Corey Kemper | Conquest of Eldinar
snippet.description:
THE KICKSTARTER IS LIVE! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/conquestofeldinar/conquest-of-eldinar-an-action-strategy-video-game

The road developing my first indie game Conquest of Eldinar has been a long one filled with many challenges, but with the Kickstarter Campaign on the horizon and the state of the alpha soaring I thought it was a good time to reflect on the journey and share with you all what has brought us this far. I hope you have a good time watching the video!

STEAM PAGE (Go Wishlist it!) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548280/Conquest_of_Eldinar/
Game Website: https://www.mythwardentertainment.com/
Conquest of Eldinar Discord Server:  https://discord.com/invite/UYej2Jev4q
